notes: Figures carry their checkedAt date from the hosted data; where a company states different figures on different official pages, each page's figure is kept with its page.

The scraper (scripts/scrape.js) re-checks canonical official pages only. The generic engine may only REPORT a differing figure, never auto-write; only the Norton/Aura/Incogni/Optery parsers may auto-write cleanly-read figures.
Refresh is MANUAL on-demand only (dashboard Refresh button, POST /api/refresh, or `node scripts/scrape.js`). There is no daily or automatic re-check and no scheduler in this package.
